feeds.title: Poultry Network
feeds.description: Poultry Network is a leading news service for commercial broiler and egg farmers, offering analysis, insight, market data, and company reports from the commercial poultry sector.

feeds.title: Poultry News
feeds.description: Dedicated to covering the entire poultry meat and egg production process, including both farming and processing. Poultry News delivers daily news updates, comments, analyses, as well as prices and market information for the poultry sector.

feeds.title: The British Poultry Council
feeds.description: Articles cover issues affecting the poultry production chain, including breeding, hatching, growing, and processing. The British Poultry Council is the trade association for those involved in the production of poultry meat, chicken, turkey, duck, and goose in the UK.

feeds.title: FarmingUK » Poultry
feeds.description: The poultry section of this blog covers the latest poultry industry news, breeding news, poultry farming features, poultry recipes, and detailed information on managing poultry health and treating poultry diseases. Farming UK offers the latest agricultural and rural news from across the UK.

feeds.title: Charlotte's Chickens Blog
feeds.description: Articles on what coops chickens need, which chickens to buy, what to feed, and generally how to look after their new additions. Charlotte's Chickens is a supplier of Hybrid chickens and accessories.

feeds.title: St David's Poultry Team
feeds.description: Covers latest poultry news, updates, disease alerts, and poultry pharm. St David's Poultry Team is the UK's largest Poultry practices run by a team of dedicated poultry vets and staff to offer poultry care throughout the industry.

feeds.title: The Poultry Site | Industry News
feeds.description: The Poultry Site features Latest poultry industry news, poultry farming features and poultry recipes plus detailed information on managing poultry health, treating poultry diseases and much more.

feeds.title: Backgarden Chickens & Poultry Blog
feeds.description: A collection of articles about poultry keeping. Articles cover poultry housing, equipment, and other poultry such as ducks, geese, and quail. Written by John Harrison and Cara Martin.

feeds.title: ChickenGuard Blog
feeds.description: Covers chicken feeding, chicken keeping, chicken of the month, and competitions. ChickenGuard is a clever little box that automatically opens and shuts your chicken coop door, protecting your flock from predators & giving you peace of mind.

feeds.title: Cluckin.net
feeds.description: We are a reference site for backyard chicken keepers with how-to's, in-depth guides, some deeper research articles, and breed and showing articles.

feeds.title: Food Manufacture
feeds.description: Get food manufacturing & processing news and information from the market-leading website for the UK's food and drink manufacturing industry. Food Manufacture is an online platform dedicated solely to readers working in the UK food and drink manufacturing industry. The site is updated daily, covering the latest news, analysis, and research.

feeds.title: Poultrykeeper
feeds.description: A hobby website for backyard poultry enthusiasts, featuring high-quality articles, information, and resources about keeping poultry. Mostly chickens, ducks, and geese but other poultry too, such as guinea fowl, turkeys, and quail.
